name: review
title: Review of {{params.session}}'s work
description: A second agent reviews a worktree's changes with its own session (headless by default, inside tmux), and its verdict can go back to the author.
tokens: The reviewer gets about 260 characters plus your criteria and reads the diff itself. Its reply is capped at 15 lines (about 2 KB), and only that goes back to the author, when send_back is set.

session.description: the session whose worktree is reviewed

send_back.description: send the review to the author and wait for its turn

steps.text: Review the uncommitted changes and the commits ahead of the base branch in this worktree. Do not edit anything. Reply in at most 15 lines: a verdict (ship / fix first), then issues as file:line - problem. {{params.criteria}}

else.text: Review the uncommitted changes and the commits ahead of the base branch here. Do not edit anything. Reply in at most 15 lines: a verdict, then issues as file:line - problem. {{params.criteria}}
